definitions: To cover or adorn with feathers.
To turn an oar so that the blade is nearly horizontal as it comes out of or enters the water, to reduce wind resistance.
To make the edges of something thin or tapered.
examples: The young birds are starting to feather.
She decided to feather her hat with peacock plumes.
The rower feathered the oar expertly.
He feathered the wood to create a smooth joint.
